text:
zoe: Quick heads-up — visiting folks from London next Wed evening :flag-gb: Need a group dinner near SOMA that can handle vegetarian + halal + celiac/gluten-free. Walkable from office, roughly 7:30–8pm, budget ~ $50pp. Open to sit-down, casual, or catering in the office. Any recs?

maria: For halal + veg, I like Tandoor Corner on 3rd — good veg mains but not sure about strict GF prep.

sam: If celiac is a hard requirement, Bloom & Bun (vegan dumpling spot by Market) will do GF on request. Small place tho, might not fit 8 people.

lia: If you want a nicer option w/ private space, Harbor Table (reservations) can do a mixed menu and accommodate halal/veg. They offered a set menu last time.

zoe: @lia — do you know if they can do a GF-only prep line? We have one guest super strict.

lia: Haven't asked specifically but they have done celiac-friendly menus for corporate groups before. I can call and confirm.

tom: Alternatively, potluck + bakery runs? I can pick up empanadas from La Abuela (they have GF empanadas on request) and we can have some salad bowls. Less stress and cheaper. :burrito:

mina: Quick poll idea — react with emoji: :fork_and_knife: = sit-down, :bento: = catering (office), :handshake: = potluck/bakery run.

rachel: :fork_and_knife: from me (prefer a long table and people can mingle)

maria: :bento: leaning catering if we can't find a place that locks down GF prep

sam: :handshake: if timing is tight — easier to host here

devops-bot: Note: If we host in office, please file a facilities request early. Example command: `/facilities reserve commons 2026-04-02 19:00` 

zoe: Thanks all — so far fork_and_knife 1, bento 1, handshake 1. Lia will check Harbor Table GF prep. If they can guarantee GF line, priority = sit-down. If not, fallback is catering or my potluck plan. I'll try to reserve Harbor Table for Wed 8pm and update here by EOD. :sparkles: :heart:
